In terms of squad availability, midfielder Otar Kiteishvili remains out of action. The visitors will rely heavily on their star forward Khvicha Kvaratskhelia, who is eager to make amends after missing a crucial penalty in their previous meeting against the Green and White Army.

Svanadze is expected to field an aggressive attacking trio, partnering Kvaratskhelia with Georges Mikautadze and Giorgi Chakvetadze upfront in hopes of finally breaking their goalscoring drought.

### Form [...] #### Georgia

Georgia, by contrast, is enduring a miserable run of form and sits at the bottom of the group. The Crusaders are still searching for their first win and first goal of the competition. Their campaign opened with a heartbreaking 1-0 home defeat to Northern Ireland and was followed by a 0-0 draw against Ukraine. Most recently, they suffered another setback with a 1-0 loss to Hungary.

### Predicted lineups [...] The tactical layout will likely see Jamie Donley leading the line as the lone striker, with Isaac Price providing creative support from an advanced midfield role.

O’Neill’s faith in the younger generation has rejuvenated the squad, and they will look to exploit their home advantage at Windsor Park to secure another vital three points.
